text:
Independent diagnostic labs don't lose patients on price. They lose them on convenience.

The big chains win with three things a smaller lab can copy in a week:

1. Home collection that's easy to book
→ A WhatsApp message with two morning slots, not a phone call to "check availability"

2. The report on the patient's phone
→ Plus one line of context: "One value is above normal, please show your doctor." A bare PDF scares people.

3. Repeat testing reminders
→ Thyroid and sugar patients test every 3 months. A reminder with a home-collection slot brings them back without a single ad.

For labs with several collection centres, add one more: route every booking to the nearest centre automatically, and alert the manager if a sample isn't picked up on time.

The lab with the friendliest process often keeps the patient, even when it isn't the biggest name.
